question: B21
title: Section 232 pharmaceutical tariffs: generics and biosimilars excluded for now
snippet: Generic pharmaceuticals, biosimilars, and their associated ingredients are expressly excluded from Section 232 tariffs at this time. Commerce is required, within one year of the Proclamation, to advise the President whether circumstances indicate a need to extend Section 232 tariffs to generic pharmaceuticals and associated ingredients.

question: B21
title: FDA draft guidance would reduce biosimilar and interchangeability studies
snippet: FDA is proposing a significantly less burdensome path for biosimilar developers, with changes that could reduce several clinical studies historically used to support biosimilar and interchangeable biosimilar applications. The recommendations remain in draft form.

question: B22
title: Biocon bets on global markets as rivals fight India's semaglutide price war
snippet: With semaglutide patents in India having expired on March 20 and over 20 Indian drugmakers already in the market with generic versions, Biocon has filed its Semaglutide in Canada, Brazil, Saudi Arabia and Turkey.
